run_challenge_submission: run the CLI script to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from results
run_is2re_from_trajectories: run the script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from a directory of .traj trajectory files
run_is2re_hybrid: run the script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF NPZ prediction files
create_submission_from_predictions: create a challenge submission NPZ file by prefixing all keys in a results file with challenge_
extract_is2re_energies: extract challenge IDs and final relaxation energies from ASE trajectory files into a compressed NPZ submission
